armyRule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** listed below. If you do, that **combat doctrine** is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

### Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

### Devastator Doctrine
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

### Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]** and **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

Unless otherwise stated:
▪ You can only select each **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** once per battle.
▪ Only one **combat doctrine** can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a **combat doctrine** active for a unit, any **combat doctrine** previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

### Transhuman Strategist
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Librarius
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a **[gloss:psyker-level:psyker level]** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each **[gloss:psychic-ability:psychic ability]** has a **psychic level** of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s **psyker level**.

Example: In a battle round, a **psyker level 3** PSYKER unit could use three **psychic level 1** abilities, or one **psychic level 1** ability and one **psychic level 2** ability, or one **psychic level 3** ability.

### Special Move Types
The following are special **[gloss:move-type:move types]** that certain or all of your units are eligible to make:
▪ **[gloss:shock-disembark-move:shock disembark move]** (18.07)
▪ **[gloss:assault-disembark-move:assault disembark move]** (18.06)
armyRule.flavor: The Space Marines draw upon the combat doctrines of the Codex Astartes as they flow through each phase of battle: first hammering the enemy with devastating firepower, then raking them with close-ranged volleys while manoeuvring to deliver a final, crushing assault.
armyRule.name: Combat Doctrines

rule.body:

▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:wound-roll:wound roll]**.
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:damage-roll:damage roll]**.
▪ Otherwise you can:
▪ Re-roll __one__ **hit roll**.
▪ __Or:__ Re-roll __one__ **wound roll**.
▪ __Or:__ Re-roll __one__ **damage roll**.

armyRule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** listed below. If you do, that **combat doctrine** is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

### Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

### Devastator Doctrine
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

### Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]** and **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

Unless otherwise stated:
▪ You can only select each **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]** once per battle.
▪ Only one **combat doctrine** can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a **combat doctrine** active for a unit, any **combat doctrine** previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

### Transhuman Strategist
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Librarius
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a **[gloss:psyker-level:psyker level]** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each **[gloss:psychic-ability:psychic ability]** has a **psychic level** of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s **psyker level**.

Example: In a battle round, a **psyker level 3** PSYKER unit could use three **psychic level 1** abilities, or one **psychic level 1** ability and one **psychic level 2** ability, or one **psychic level 3** ability.

### Special Move Types
The following are special **[gloss:move-type:move types]** that certain or all of your units are eligible to make:
▪ **[gloss:shock-disembark-move:shock disembark move]** (18.07)
▪ **[gloss:assault-disembark-move:assault disembark move]** (18.06)
armyRule.flavor: The Space Marines draw upon the combat doctrines of the Codex Astartes as they flow through each phase of battle: first hammering the enemy with devastating firepower, then raking them with close-ranged volleys while manoeuvring to deliver a final, crushing assault.
armyRule.name: Combat Doctrines

stratagems.name: Umbral Evasion

stratagems.name: Transhuman Reactions

enhancements.flavor: This champion hurls himself forwards with unbridled ferocity, cutting down the foe like a reaping whirlwind.
enhancements.name: Imperium’s Sword

enhancements.flavor: Bellicose temperament and advanced training combine to make this unit especially terrifying on the charge.
enhancements.name: Furious Assault (Upgrade)

rule.flavor: Space Marines who specialise in close-quarters brutality truly embody their sobriquet ‘Angels of Death’.
rule.name: Assault Mastery

stratagems.flavor: Space Marines are blessed with incredible strength.
stratagems.name: Gene-wrought Might

enhancements.flavor: This war leader excels in harrying tactics, wielding their strike force like a weapon of utmost stealth and cunning.
enhancements.name: Execute and Redeploy

rule.body:
When a friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot:
▪ Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being **[gloss:hidden:hidden]**.
▪ __Or:__ That unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to D6". That unit is __not__ **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]** until the end of the turn.
rule.flavor: Holding to the shadows and choosing victims with care, Phobos-armoured Astartes winnow the enemy ranks without ever revealing their positions.
rule.name: Shadow Masters

If your unit is controlling an **[gloss:objective:objective]**, that **objective** is **[gloss:sm-snared:snared]**. While an **objective** is **snared**, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that **objective**, roll one D6:
▪ On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
▪ That **objective** is no longer **snared**.
stratagems.flavor: These stealth operatives lace the battlefield with explosive devices that trigger by micro-auspex and las-wire when foes blunder into them.
stratagems.name: Mortis Snares
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.
stratagems.flavor: At an opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
stratagems.name: Tactical withdrawal

enhancements.body: GRAVIS model only. This unit has [core:Scouts 5"].
enhancements.flavor: Ever on the move, this warrior leads his battle-brothers in a tireless crusade across the battlefields of the 41st millennium.
enhancements.name: Relentless Advance

enhancements.flavor: Renowned for being a living engine of war, this warrior inspires his comrades to shrug off even the most devastating attacks.
enhancements.name: Indefatigable Fortitude

rule.body:
In a turn a friendly GRAVIS unit made a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]**, that unit’s ranged attacks:
▪ Do not have [HEAVY].
▪ Have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
rule.flavor: With their plan in motion and targets designated, Gravis-armoured warriors stride unstoppably into battle as they lay down withering hails of firepower.
rule.name: Walking Fortress

stratagems.effect:
▪ If your unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**, your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.
▪ Your unit is __not__ **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]** or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.
stratagems.flavor: Gravis assault tactics stipulate a relentless advance coupled with unfaltering firepower.
stratagems.name: Purgation Push
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.

stratagems.effect:

▪ For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.
stratagems.flavor: Throwing their armoured mass into an assault, a Space Marine in Gravis armour can crush and trample their foe.
stratagems.name: Armoured Impact
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
stratagems.flavor: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
stratagems.name: Annihilating Force
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has:
▪ 2+ **[gloss:save:Sv]**.
▪ [core:Feel No Pain 5+].
enhancements.flavor: Originally worn by a storied Captain of the Ultramarines’ First Company, this artificer armour is bestowed by the Chapter Master himself upon a worthy wearer.
enhancements.name: Armour of Antoninus

enhancements.body: CAPTAIN model only. The **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:tactical doctrine]** is active for this unit __in addition__ to any other **combat doctrine**.
enhancements.flavor: This prodigal officer has focused upon one aspect of the Codex Astartes and means to master its every aspect before moving on to the next.
enhancements.name: Student of the Codex

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
▪ +1 **[gloss:strength:S]** and **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.
▪ __Or:__ If the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:assault doctrine]** is active for this unit, +2 **S** and **AP**.
enhancements.flavor: Amongst the most solemn and binding oaths an Ultramarine can swear, it is a rare honour to enter battle with these words affixed to their armour.
enhancements.name: Oath of Macragge

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
enhancements.flavor: Having battled the Tyranid swarms since their first galactic invasion, this veteran officer knows well the benefit of efficient and overwhelming firepower.
enhancements.name: Veteran of Behemoth

rule.body:
If your army includes a MARNEUS CALGAR unit, you can select the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:assault doctrine]/devastator doctrine/tactical doctrine** each one additional time per battle.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include ULTRAMARINES units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.flavor: Marneus Calgar deploys the complete and nuanced wisdom of the Codex Astartes as easily and instinctively as drawing breath.
rule.name: Mastered Doctrines

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:combat doctrine]**. That **combat doctrine** is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
stratagems.flavor: No Chapter’s warriors know better the breadth – theoretical and practical – of the Codex Astartes’ teachings, and how these can and should be adapted to ensure victory.
stratagems.name: Ultramarian Adaptivity
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
stratagems.flavor: Long have the Ultramarines guarded both Ultramar and the wider Imperium. No foe can hide from their vengeful gaze or evade the reach of their wrath.
stratagems.name: Exemplary Vigilance
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
stratagems.flavor: Roaring their famed battle cry, the Ultramarines hurl themselves into the fight, striving all the harder to prevail beneath the unwavering eye of their Chapter Master.
stratagems.name: Courage and Honour!
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.

stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a **[gloss:strength:S]** greater than this unit’s **[gloss:toughness:T]** have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: With the enemy’s countermeasures and responses predicted and allowed for in advance, the Ultramarines can weather their most ferocious attacks.
stratagems.name: Tactical Foresight
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

stratagems.name: Practical Tactics

enhancements.flavor: This unique vox‑and‑augur augmetic provides the bearer with unparalleled tactical data vital to coordinating an aggressive defence in battle.
enhancements.name: Castellum Omnivox

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. This unit’s ranged weapons have [IGNORES COVER].
enhancements.flavor: Several artificer‑crafted and heavily shrouded servo‑skulls are tethered to this device, their linked visual feeds making the bearer nigh impossible to evade.
enhancements.name: Spy-skull Data Link

enhancements.body:
GRAVIS model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, roll one D6:
▪ On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was **destroyed**, **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**, with 3 wounds remaining.
enhancements.flavor: This rare honour badge celebrates a warrior who refuses to give up, even in the face of apparently certain death.
enhancements.name: Honour Indefatigable

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units. When doing so, you can set those units up in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**, regardless of how many units are already in **strategic reserves**.
enhancements.flavor: Few officers of the Chapter can match this commander’s talent for cunning defensive troop dispositions.
enhancements.name: Defensive Mastery

rule.body:
▪ While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a **[gloss:terrain-area:terrain area]**, that unit’s attacks can re-roll **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.
▪ Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units are **[gloss:sm-entrenched:entrenched]** while all of the following apply:
▪ That unit is within a **terrain area**.
▪ That unit was not set up this turn.
▪ No model in that unit moved more than 3" this turn.
▪ Friendly DARNATH LYSANDER/TOR GARADON units have the following ability:

**Defensive Mastery**: At the start of each phase, this unit is **entrenched**.

Darnath Lysander's/Tor Garadon's unit is always **entrenched**, regardless of the conditions listed above.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include IMPERIAL FISTS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.flavor: These Space Marines are experts in fighting from rapidly prepared defensive positions. They are able to maximise the potential of almost any terrain to serve as an ad‑hoc strongpoint, rapidly assessing optimal firing lines and punishing the foe’s every attempt to advance and dislodge them.
rule.name: Adaptive Defence

▪ [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is **[gloss:sm-entrenched:entrenched]**, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
stratagems.flavor: Auto‑sense targeting subroutines specially adapted for defensive fire patterns aid these warriors’ aim.
stratagems.name: Augmented Targeting
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.

Your unit is __not__ able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.
stratagems.flavor: Codex doctrine when conducting an aggressive defence is to swiftly take up new positions whenever the foe finds your range.
stratagems.name: Evasive Repositioning

stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 **[gloss:objective-control:OC]** until the end of the turn.
stratagems.flavor: Knowing that this strategically vital site must be secure for the defence lines to hold, Space Marines stand indomitable in the face of the foe.
stratagems.name: Unyielding Might

stratagems.when: Command phase.

▪ __Or:__ If your unit is **[gloss:sm-entrenched:entrenched]**, attacks that target your unit have -1 to **wound rolls**.
stratagems.flavor: Aware of how vital it is that the defence line holds, these warriors fight even to their last breath.
stratagems.name: Stand to the End
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).

stratagems.effect:
You can select the **[gloss:objective-consolidation:objective consolidation]** mode for that **[gloss:consolidation:consolidation move]**, regardless of that **consolidation move**’s Before Moving restrictions.

**Designer’s Note:** This means your unit can move out of **[gloss:engagement-range:engagement range]** with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the

**objective consolidation mode**.
stratagems.flavor: Steadfast and determined, the Imperial Fists favour methodical advances, securing and consolidating positions to establish battlefield dominance before turning their attention to the elimination of remaining foes.
stratagems.name: Establish Supremacy
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly **[gloss:sm-entrenched:entrenched]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a **[gloss:consolidation:consolidation move]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: Eliminating key enemy assets is crucial to stalling then reversing the foe’s momentum.
stratagems.name: Priority Strike
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model:
▪ Has +1 **[gloss:toughness:T]**.
▪ Has [core:Feel No Pain 5+].
enhancements.flavor: The injuries of past battles have seen this warrior heavily rebuilt with ultra-durable cybernetic limbs and organs that render them extremely difficult to kill.
enhancements.name: The Flesh is Weak

enhancements.body:
TECHMARINE model only.

In your movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this unit. That VEHICLE model’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS] until the start of your next Command phase
enhancements.flavor: This spearhead commander uses advanced augmetics to distribute targeting data. With these, they direct the fire of their war engine crews and rouse their machine spirits to operative superiority.
enhancements.name: Target Augury Web

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only.

In your Movement phase, you can select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6” of this model and then select the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:devastator doctrine]** or **tactical doctrine**. That doctrine is active for that VEHICLE unit until the start of your next Command phase.
enhancements.flavor:
This commander is supremely gifted in the strategies of armoured warfare, understanding the capabilities of every war engine in the Chapter’s arsenal. Delivering precision orders, they ensure the vehicles under their command inflict the most punishing damage to the

enemy even amidst complex manoeuvres.
enhancements.name: Master of the Machine War

enhancements.body:
TECHMARINE model only.

(Once per battle round, per army) When an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6” of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, that VEHICLE unit has [core:Feel No Pain 5+] until that enemy unit has attacked.
enhancements.flavor: This battle-brother is steeped in hidden technological rites. Should their armoured charges be threatened, a burst of arcane Binharic screed can rouse their machine spirits to vigilance.
enhancements.name: Adept of the Omnissiah

rule.body:
Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]** or **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:
▪ If that unit is within 6" of a friendly CANNOK VAR/IRON FATHER FEIRROS unit you can:
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:hit-roll:hit roll]**.
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:wound-roll:wound roll]**.
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:damage-roll:damage roll]**.
▪ Otherwise you can:
▪ Re-roll __one__ **hit roll**.
▪ __Or:__ Re-roll __one__ **wound roll**.
▪ __Or:__ Re-roll __one__ **damage roll**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include IRON HANDS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.name: Armoured Wrath

▪ If your unit is a VEHICLE unit, have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
stratagems.name: Methodical Brutality
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
stratagems.flavor: These warriors emulate the mechanical monstrosities at whose side they fight, shrugging off wounds both physical and spiritual.
stratagems.name: Spirits of Iron
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.

stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
▪ **[gloss:ballistic-skill:BS]** and **[gloss:weapon-skill:WS]**.
▪ **[gloss:hit-roll:Hit rolls]** and **[gloss:wound-roll:Wound rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: Space Marines exemplify obdurate tenacity. Even severely injured, they will never abandon their oaths.
stratagems.name: Unbowed Conviction
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is **[gloss:below-starting-strength:below starting strength]**.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Change any [core:Deadly Demise] rolls made for this unit to an unmodified 6.
stratagems.flavor: Carefully cogitated binharic prayers can focus a machine spirit’s ire into near-obsessive hatred of its slayers, ensuring that vengeance is meted out even in death.
stratagems.name: Vengeful Animus
stratagems.target: That friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, before rolling for deadly demise.

stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has:
▪ +1” **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]**.
▪ +1 **[gloss:toughness:T]**.
▪ +1 **[gloss:leadership:Ld]**.
▪ +1 **[gloss:objective-control:OC]**.
▪ +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: The heroes entombed within Dreadnoughts have fought across countless war zones throughout their extended existences, perfecting their martial prowess beyond mortal limits.
stratagems.name: Ancient Fury
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit shoots using:
▪ **[gloss:snap-shooting:Snap shooting]**.
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is **[gloss:half-strength:at half-strength]**/**below half-strength**, **[gloss:normal-shooting:normal shooting]**.

While doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.flavor: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crew of their vehicle are slain and critical systems are failing.
stratagems.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit has shot.

enhancements.body: PHOBOS model only. Each enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE UNITS) **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with this unit cannot be targeted by controlling player **[gloss:stratagem:stratagems]**.
enhancements.flavor: This wreath of circuitry from the Dark Age of Technology forces a whispering white noise into enemy minds and broadcasts, impeding communications and interrupting the chain of command.
enhancements.name: Coronal Susurrant

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. This unit has [core:Infiltrators].
enhancements.flavor: This mechanical device contains miniaturised refraction fields and electromagnetic interference projectors that distort sensory apparatus, enabling the bearer and their unit to evade detection and infiltrate key positions.
enhancements.name: Blackwing Shroud

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. This model has:
▪ [core:Fights First].
▪ [core:Lone Operative].
enhancements.flavor: This warrior is a solitary predator whose footsteps are all but silent and whose form is one with the shadows.
enhancements.name: Umbral Raptor

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**.
enhancements.flavor: Those who master the Path of Ambush guide their forces to launch surprise assaults on the enemy with the precise timing of true hunters.
enhancements.name: Hunter’s Instincts

rule.body:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have [core:Stealth].

Friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD units have -3" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.

Friendly AETHON SHAAN units have the following ability:

**Unparalleled Tactician**: (Once per battle round, per army) When you use the **Into Darkness stratagem**, that use is -1CP.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include RAVEN GUARD units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.flavor: The Raven Guard are renowned for their uncanny ability to move unseen, cloaking themselves in darkness as they close in upon their prey. Aethon Shaan is a true master at harnessing these abilities, withdrawing and redeploying his battle-brothers to draw the enemy out of formation.
rule.name: Shadow Tactics

stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.
stratagems.flavor: At the opportune moment, Raven Guard infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
stratagems.name: Into Darkness
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
▪ +1**[gloss:ballistic-skill:BS]**.
▪ +1**[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.
stratagems.flavor: From darkness and obscuring cover, Raven Guard battle‑brothers open fire as one, striking their unaware targets with precision fire.
stratagems.name: Murderous Fusillade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that made an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]** this turn is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].
stratagems.flavor: In a storm of blade thrusts and bludgeoning strikes, enemy champions and commanders are laid low, leaving their troops in leaderless disarray.
stratagems.name: Lay Low the Tyrants
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.

stratagems.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:hidden:hidden]**.
stratagems.flavor: The Raven Guard commonly utilise integral suppressors, flash-hiders and other technology to dampen weapon reports and conceal muzzle flare, enabling battle-brothers to fire on unsuspecting foes without giving away their positions.
stratagems.name: Suppressed Weapons
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit has shot.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of:
▪ Up to D6”.
▪ __Or:__ If your unit is a PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit, up to 6”.
stratagems.flavor: The Raven Guard are swift to exploit the movements of their foes, whether to pursue their prey and complete the kill or to make use of an opportunity to fade once more from sight.
stratagems.name: Raptorial Vigilance
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

stratagems.effect: The **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:tactical doctrine]** is active for your unit in addition to any other **combat doctrine**, until the start of your next Command phase.
stratagems.flavor: Retreating from the fight, these warriors lure their enemies on before swiftly turning the tables and hurling themselves into their now overextended foe.
stratagems.name: Feint and Thrust
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
▪ +1 **[gloss:strength:S]**.
▪ +1 **[gloss:damage-roll:D]**.
enhancements.flavor: Having laboured long in the Chapter’s forges, this warrior smith has crafted his personal armaments. Each weapon is a masterwork tool of death‑dealing, wrought with care and strength, and embellished with the icons of their maker’s brotherhood.
enhancements.name: War Tempered Artifice

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Attacks allocated to this model have -1**[gloss:damage-roll:D]**.
enhancements.flavor: This flowing cloak or finely wrought tabard is laced through with threads of braided adamantine. When combined with armour and energy fields, it has been shown time and again that these symbols of office are proof against even the very strongest attacks.
enhancements.name: Adamantine Mantle

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit can ignore modifiers to:
▪ **[gloss:ballistic-skill:BS]**.
▪ **[gloss:weapon-skill:WS]**.
▪ **[gloss:hit-roll:Hit rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: To this Angel of Death, war is the anvil upon which their strength is wrought. Every battle is seen as a test in which they and their battle‑brothers can prove themselves, and the superior craftsmanship of their weapons and armour.
enhancements.name: Forged in Battle

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s [TORRENT] weapons have +1**[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
enhancements.flavor: Steeped in the Promethean Cult, this battle‑brother wields the flamer with unparalleled mastery, turning the battlefield into a burning pyre for the corpses of his foes.
enhancements.name: Immolator

rule.body:
▪ You can select the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:devastator doctrine]** one additional time per battle.
▪ Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units’ ranged attacks that target a unit within 12”, have +1 **[gloss:strength:S]**.

If your army includes a VULKAN HE’STAN unit, friendly INFERNUS SQUAD units have the following:
▪ When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, that **advance/fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.
▪ When this unit **[gloss:action:starts an action]**, that **action** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include SALAMANDERS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.flavor: Tireless in his pursuit of the Primarch’s legacy, Forgefather Vulkan He’stan annihilates any who impede his quest. Favouring swift, aggressive assaults, he and his warriors close rapidly with the enemy, destroying them at close range with ruthless efficiency
rule.name: Vulkan's Quest

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can:
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
▪ Re-roll **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.
stratagems.flavor: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.
stratagems.name: Crucible of Battle
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]** an enemy unit within 6”.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1**[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.
stratagems.flavor: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.
stratagems.name: Immolation Protocols
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-attack:selected to attack]**.

stratagems.effect:
Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can:
▪ Make a **[gloss:disembark:disembark move]**.
▪ Shoot using **[gloss:normal-shooting:normal shooting]**, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.flavor: To open fire on warriors of the Salamanders is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.
stratagems.name: Burning Vengeance
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has ‑1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: When faced with an onrushing horde, the Forgefather’s warriors set fire to the earth beneath their feet, impeding their advance and throwing them into confusion.
stratagems.name: Blazing Earth
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more TORRENT/MELTA weapons.
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s TORRENT weapons:
▪ Do not have [BLAST].
▪ Have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
▪ Have +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
stratagems.flavor: The Salamanders are masters of the flamer, wielding such weapons with supreme precision and utilising them even in the press of melee combat.
stratagems.name: Forged in Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: The **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:assault doctrine]** __or__ **tactical doctrine** is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.
stratagems.flavor: Having drawn their enemies in, Space Marine battle-brothers fall back and open fire at point-blank range before thundering forward to put any survivors to death.
stratagems.name: Wrath and Ruin
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
▪ +1 **[gloss:strength:S]** and **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.
▪ __Or:__ If this unit made a **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]** this turn, +2 **S** and **AP**.
enhancements.flavor: Decades of service within the White Scars First Company have helped this superlative warrior master the violent arts of high‑speed combat.
enhancements.name: Spearpoint Paragon

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit can re-roll **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: The Chapter’s Librarians have made this champion privy to omens of great threats in future wars. Armed with this knowledge, they lead their warriors to war with a boldness that some mistake for recklessness.
enhancements.name: Stormseer's Wisdom

enhancements.body: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit only. When this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]**, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.
enhancements.flavor: This mounted huntsman knows well the importance of manoeuvre, outflanking the enemy and ambushing unsuspecting foes from the flanks and rear, the better to land the killing blow.
enhancements.name: Chogorian Huntmaster (Upgrade)

enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks:
▪ Have [IGNORES COVER].
▪ Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
enhancements.flavor: This augmetic eye enhances the user’s visual spectrum, enabling them to pinpoint heat signatures and cogitate appropriate firing solutions.
enhancements.name: Hunter’s Eye

rule.body:
▪ You can select the **[gloss:sm-combat-doctrine:assault doctrine]** __or__ **tactical doctrine** one additional time per battle.
▪ Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +1 to **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]**.

Friendly SUBODEN KHAN units have the following ability:

**Wrath of the First Khan:** At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was **[gloss:eligible-to-fight:eligible to fight]** this phase, you can use this ability. If you do:
▪ If this unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]**, this unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]**.
▪ __Or:__ If this unit is **[gloss:engaged:engaged]**, this unit can make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.

**Restrictions:** Your army can include WHITE SCARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.flavor: The White Scars are masters of high‑speed tactics and hit‑and‑run warfare. They do battle on the move and from the saddle, outwitting their enemies with breakneck manoeuvres and melting away one moment only to crash home with bone‑crushing force the next.
rule.name: Storm-swift Onslaught

stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.
stratagems.flavor: The riders and pilots sweep away as swiftly as they arrive, regrouping in preparation for their next assault.
stratagems.name: Withdraw and Regroup
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to D3+3”.
stratagems.flavor: The White Scars read the ebb and flow of battle with the hungry cunning of raptorial predators, reacting to the enemy’s movements with exceptional rapidity.
stratagems.name: Hunter's Instincts
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks:
▪ Have [LETHAL HITS].
▪ __Or:__ Have [LANCE].
▪ __Or:__ If your unit has MOUNTED, have [LETHAL HITS] and [LANCE].
stratagems.flavor: Some foes can be ended with a single charge. Others require sustained savagery to fell. The White Scars are adept at both methods of fighting.
stratagems.name: Spear Thrust and Sabre Swing
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.
stratagems.flavor: Skilled Space Marine riders can guide their steeds through even the densest and most treacherous terrain to strike their foes from the position they least expect.
stratagems.name: Flawless Riders
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]** or **[gloss:declare-charge:declares a charge]**.

stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.
stratagems.flavor: Battle‑brothers of the White Scars Chapter are born and raised in the saddle. Expert pilots and riders all, they weave through incoming fire with instinctive skill.
stratagems.name: Evasive Manoeuvers
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

stratagems.effect:
▪ That **fall-back** move does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.
▪ Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
stratagems.flavor: The White Scars fight their wars at a furious tempo, and their warriors are adept at fire‑and‑manoeuvre strategies.
stratagems.name: Mobile Lethality
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.
